answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Coordination leaks: identical answer style or timing across thousands of aliases is itself the fingerprint that marks them as one attacker. Consider a prism at the center, a ferrous resting nearby, and a ledge beyond the hills: three anchors, none forged, all earned over time.
